主要内容: Sandisk Corp shareholders voted to elect eight individuals for the upcoming year and until their successors are elected and qualified. The results for each candidate were as follows: Michael E. Marks (For: 170,943,872, Against: 6,839,619, Abstain: 669,798, Broker Non-Votes: 24,729,663), Kevin DeNuccio (For: 173,753,909, Against: 4,158,693, Abstain: 540,687, Broker Non-Votes: 24,729,663), and others. Shareholders also ratified the selection of Ernst & Young LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending December 30, 2012. Additionally, they approved the advisory resolution on executive compensation.
